verdict.rationale: Alloy's Sandbox is a per-request mode that skips vendor calls, which makes it a dry-run of vendor calls rather than an isolated environment. The vendor explicitly states that Sandbox and Production are not separate environments, that no data boundary is enforced, and that Entities live in a single shared data store regardless of mode. Testing without touching production data is therefore not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: They are per-request processing modes only - Alloy does not enforce a data boundary. Most records in Alloy, including Entities, live in a single shared data store for your account, regardless of the mode used to create or update them.
